source: Live recording from DeepSeek (deepseek-flash) through its Anthropic-format API, 2026-09-27.

content.text: Rin's message doesn't actually say what she wants for tomorrow — it's just a line about a sunset boat, with no day, time or plan attached. I can't book anything from a chat message anyway; bookings only happen through the app's own offer cards, with someone confirming. Want me to look at what's on the plan for tomorrow so we can see where a sunset boat might fit?
